mainEntity.name: Can custom trim be installed if my walls and door openings are not perfect?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most residential trim jobs can be done if the walls, floors, and openings are already in decent shape. If there is moisture damage, missing drywall, out-of-square corners, or prior sloppy work, the trim still can be installed, but the prep work usually becomes part of the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Usually yes, but uneven walls, damaged drywall, or crooked openings may need prep first. The more off-square the space is, the more fitting and repair work the job needs.
